pages.text: The river fell overnight. By morning, all the steps down to the bottom were exposed. The river was very quiet.
Mina called Raju and Sonu to the steps. "Let's all play together!" But they wanted different things.
Raju said, "Let's throw stones." Sonu said, "No! I like getting my feet wet!"
Standing between them, Mina decided. "Stones first, then water play. Ten turns for Raju, ten for Sonu."
Raju turned away. "Why do you decide?" Sonu turned away, too. "I'm not playing."
Mina sat alone on the steps.
Raju sat far above; Sonu far below. All three were apart.
Mom asked from the top, "What did Raju say? And Sonu?"
Mina climbed to Raju. "Sonu likes getting wet feet." From below, Sonu looked toward Mina.
All three sat on the lowest step. Raju threw a stone. Splash! The spray hit Sonu, who laughed and laughed.
